@@ -1,11 +1,11 @@
 # trussbars-import — exhaustive parsers for foreign template dialects (Mustache,
-# Handlebars, Liquid, StringTemplate4), the *read half* of the docs/14 migration
+# Handlebars, Liquid, StringTemplate4), the *read half* of the docs/15 migration
 # tool. Each dialect parses to its own faithful AST; the lowering to the Trussbars
 # AST is the next deliverable. Hand-rolled, zero external deps, like every crate
 # in the workspace.
 [package]
 name = "trussbars-import"
-description = "Exhaustive parsers for foreign template dialects (Mustache, Handlebars, Liquid, StringTemplate4) — the read half of the Trussbars migration tool (docs/14). Each dialect parses to a faithful, byte-spanned AST; the lowering to the Trussbars AST is a separate deliverable."
+description = "Exhaustive parsers for foreign template dialects (Mustache, Handlebars, Liquid, StringTemplate4) — the read half of the Trussbars migration tool (docs/15). Each dialect parses to a faithful, byte-spanned AST; the lowering to the Trussbars AST is a separate deliverable."
 version.workspace = true
 edition.workspace = true
 rust-version.workspace = true

@@ -130,7 +130,7 @@ by the review:

Keep `server.mjs`, the vocabulary, the `operations.json` projection. Prerequisite: the Rust core must expose lexer/parser/diagnostics as a **library API** *before* any editor work — an earlier, separate deliverable the proposal buried inside "step 3". |
-| **Migration tool** *(priority)* | **A port, not net-new** — *for the cross-MaxBars-dialect half.* `packages/linter/src/Linter/{Lower,Migrate,Aliases,Print}.purs` already implements cross-dialect lowering + migration; `check:tutorial-tooling` gates it. +| **Migration tool** *(priority)* | **A port, not net-new** — *for the cross-MaxBars-dialect half.* `packages/linter/src/Linter/{Lower,Migrate,Aliases,Print}.purs` already implements cross-dialect lowering + migration; `check:tutorial-tooling` gates it. The **foreign-engine half** (Mustache/Handlebars/Liquid/StringTemplate4 → `.truss`) has no PureScript precedent. **Read half SHIPPED** — `crates/trussbars-import` parses all four foreign dialects to faithful, byte-spanned ASTs (`docs/15`). | Port the cross-dialect rewrite to Rust; conformance-test the Rust output against the PureScript reference *while it still exists*. Once external crates depend on Trussbars, error messages are a public API with no regression net. **This is the cheapest, highest-leverage adoption work and the proposal omitted it.** |
 | `dragonbox_ecma` float formatting | the load-bearing semantic that makes byte-identity work (chosen to match JS `String(n)`). | Pin as a **named, separately-tested frozen invariant** — one regression breaks every conformance case at once. |
